nodes.summary: Let $\Phi$ be a Blum measure, $t$ a function from $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{N}$ and $f$ a partial function from $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{N}$. Then $f$ lies in the Blum class of $t$ with respect to $\Phi$ if and only if there are a program $c$ that computes $f$ and a threshold $N$ such that for every input $n \ge N$ the cost $\Phi_c(n)$ is defined and at most $t(n)$.
nodes.title: Blum classes via an explicit threshold

nodes.summary: Given a Blum measure $\Phi$ and a function $t$ from $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{N}$, the Blum class of $t$ consists of the partial functions $f$ from $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{N}$ that are computed by some program $c$ whose cost $\Phi_c(n)$ is defined and at most $t(n)$ for all but finitely many inputs $n$.
nodes.title: Blum complexity class

nodes.summary: A Blum measure $\Phi$ assigns to every program $c$ and input $n \in \mathbb{N}$ a partially defined cost $\Phi_c(n) \in \mathbb{N}$ satisfying Blum's two axioms: $\Phi_c(n)$ is defined exactly when program $c$ halts on input $n$, and the relation $\Phi_c(n) = m$ between $c$, $n$ and $m$ is decidable.
nodes.title: Blum complexity measure

nodes.summary: If `t` is eventually dominated by `t'`, every function in the `t`-class is in the `t'`-class.
nodes.title: Blum classes are monotone in the bound

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
